en-US:
Version 2.0.0 - Sync Your Groups
• New features: Sync groups across devices via Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or your own Google Drive • New features: Secure QR pairing with end-to-end encryption • Improvements: Faster expense entry with payer and category chips, plus a new Appearance page • Bug fixes: In-app updates now install correctly, and many other fixes • Thanks for using Caravella!

版本 2.0.0 - 群组同步
